validation.coordinate_assignment: Common100-cell player-position axes across every layout
validation.interpretation: Oracle profiles only. In Sokoban a complete success goal is uniquely determined within a layout by its player cell, so100 globally shared axes suffice for the capped labels, without a query-goal-conditioned state vector. Padding to128 and a common coordinate shift fit the open Sigmoid output range. This does not establish that the fixed-width MLP or CNN can compute or learn those profiles, nor cover arbitrary intermediate goals or true infinity.
